description: Fail-closed completion scan executed from the sandbox-protected .codex directory. Hook commands use a fixed path relative to the project root the harness launches them from; they must never be resolved through a shell command that depends on the invoking process's cwd or git state, since that cwd can point inside a different (nested or attacker-planted) git repository and silently substitute a different script.
